recognize_zh: 原始細胞中大、細胞質淡藍，核有明顯凹陷、折疊呈杯口狀（cup-like）或不規則形，部分細胞質有小空泡；流式 HLA-DR 幾乎全陰性、CD45 弱陽性，HLA-DR 陰性不只見於 APL，也可見於 NPM1 突變 AML。
features: Medium to large blasts with moderate pale to deep blue agranular cytoplasm
Irregular nuclei with prominent folds, clefts, and cup-like invaginations
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods or heavy granulation seen
Flow: blast gate on low side scatter (91.5%); HLA-DR essentially negative (0.1%); CD45 uniformly dim-positive (99.9%)
Flow: CD34 histogram shows a broad peak with a gated fraction labeled 93.2%; positivity threshold is not clear from the plot
describe_en: Smear panels show a population of medium to large blasts with moderate agranular blue cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin, and irregular nuclei with folds and cup-like invaginations; occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles are present and no Auer rods are identified. Flow cytometric histograms show a low side scatter blast population that is HLA-DR negative and dim CD45 positive, with a CD34 histogram whose positivity cannot be judged reliably without the gate threshold. The morphology is not that of hypergranular promyelocytes. Findings are consistent with HLA-DR-negative acute myeloid leukemia, which in this case represents AML with NPM1 mutation, confirmed by molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL also shows HLA-DR negativity and folded bilobed nuclei but typically has strong MPO, faggot cells, CD34/CD2 patterns, coagulopathy, and PML::RARA, so genetic testing is required.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, are usually HLA-DR positive, and express CD14/CD64/CD11b.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and express TdT with B (CD19, CD79a) or T (cCD3) lineage markers rather than myeloid antigens.
